Optional iCloud Documents mirror. See plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-d-like-to-make-velvety-wreath.md (read only this phase's section).
acceptance_criteria: Reducer tests: still/shaking/tilted, second-boundary bucketing, ACC-without-HR ordering. Overnight motion table shows stillness/posture changes; file <1 MB/night.

acceptance_criteria: LiveMetrics on a fixture equals HRVKit batch at each stride; pacer phase math; windows refuse <60 beats. Ramp walk: on-device a1 matches hrv-ramp-test on exported DB within +-0.05.

Replaces StrapLog/Polar/PolarSDKLink.swift. See plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-d-like-to-make-velvety-wreath.md (read only this phase's section).

title: P2 StrapLogCore model, schema, RecordingSession
description: Database (GRDB migration v1 from docs/SCHEMA.md), record types, HeartSource protocol + SensorEvent, FakeHeartSource (scripted, injectable clock), RecordingSession actor (start/stop/marker/ingest, open-session detection, resumeIfOpen), Clock protocol, BeatTiming, Snapshot (VACUUM INTO), DBInvariants helper. acceptance_criteria: In-memory GRDB tests: 0/1/2/3 RRs -> correct beat rows and t_end_ms_est; rr_1024 conversion exact; disconnect/reconnect -> paired events; kill-and-resume -> same recording_id, relaunch event, no duplicate start; stop sets ended_at_ms; snapshot opens with plain sqlite3, no sidecars, equal row counts; migration idempotent; n_rr == count(beat). docs/SCHEMA.md matches migration.

title: P1 HRVKit pure algorithms
description: RRCleaner (300-2000 ms gate + iterative 5-beat median, 0.25), TimeDomain (RMSSD, LnRMSSD, SDNN, meanHR), DFA alpha1 (scales 4-16), SlidingWindow<T> (120 s / 60 s), ArtifactRate. tools/gen_fixtures.py (uv) from ~/Downloads/hrv260420/DB.sqlite -> Tests/fixtures/<rec>.json with Python reference metrics from analyze_h10.py. See plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-d-like-to-make-velvety-wreath.md (read only this phase's section).
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic tests (constant RR SDNN 0; alternating known RMSSD; white noise a1~0.5; random walk a1~1.5); fixture parity vs Python (RMSSD/SDNN +-0.1 ms, a1 +-0.02, identical artifact counts) on >=3 recordings (resting, strength, overnight); <60 beats -> nil; empty input; NaN handling.
